# Alternative verification method using tuple-based transaction storage and functional filtering

transactions = [
    ("2024-04-15", 910.57, "EUR", "paid"),

]

# Different approach: use comprehension with direct conversion
eur_rate = 1.07
start = "2024-05-24"
end = "2024-07-10"

# Convert all to USD and filter in one pass
usd_amounts = [
    (amount * eur_rate) if currency == "EUR" else amount
    for date, amount, currency, status in transactions
    if start <= date <= end and status == "paid"
]

# Calculate average using different method
average_value = sum(usd_amounts) / len(usd_amounts)
final_answer = round(average_value, 2)

print(f"ANSWER: {final_answer}")
